name: cccomplete
description: Completes the word at the end of your prompt from a trie of your conversation, with an inline suggestion and a bar of alternatives

accept_key.title: Accept key
accept_key.description: Keys that accept the shown suggestion, separated by commas. Examples: right, ctrl+e, ctrl+y.

next_key.title: Next-suggestion key
next_key.description: Key that moves to the next suggestion. A letter needs ctrl or meta.

previous_key.title: Previous-suggestion key
previous_key.description: Key that moves to the previous suggestion. A letter needs ctrl or meta.

display.title: Display
display.description: Where suggestions appear: inline in the prompt (the typeahead menu lists them too), in a bar above it, or both.

bar_style.title: Bar style
bar_style.description: How the bar draws matches: powerline segments (needs a Nerd Font) or plain buttons you can click.

ghost_color.title: Inline suggestion colour
ghost_color.description: How the inline text is painted: dim, a colour name, or a hex colour. Use your terminal's background colour, such as #1e1e1e, to hide it while the keys still work.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.description: Words loaded at session start: bundled, none, or the path of a dictionary file (one word per line, best first).

limit.title: Suggestions shown
limit.description: How many suggestions the bar offers, from 1 to 9.

min_prefix.title: Minimum letters
min_prefix.description: How many letters you type before suggestions appear, from 1 to 4.

trailing_space.title: Add a space after accepting
trailing_space.description: Add a space after an accepted word.

predict_next.title: Predict the next word
predict_next.description: After a space, suggest the word that most often followed the one before it.

typeahead.title: List matches in the typeahead
typeahead.description: Also list matches in Claude Code's own typeahead menu, where tab takes one.

trace.title: Trace
trace.description: Keep the last 20 hook events (keys, lookups, timings, session start steps) and list them in /cccomplete. No draft text is kept.

sources.title: Words come from
sources.description: Which text feeds the trie: your prompts, Claude's answers, or both.
